data.body: RP-03 retry-budget calibration research (2026-08-17; proposal pending maintainer decision). Atlassian Cloud guidance uses bounded exponential backoff with jitter, an example two-second base/four retries/30-second delay ceiling, idempotency gating, and can return very long Retry-After values. Maintained GitLab Jira Connect uses three entity-worker retries; Sentry uses five isolated per-external-issue task retries; controller-runtime and Crossplane favor delayed per-object requeue/re-observation over holding a finite pass open. Current Rebar visible policies cluster at 3 total attempts with 6-7 seconds fallback sleep, while hidden DC SDK layering was experimentally shown to multiply calls to 12 or 16. ADR 0087s 60-second LLM wait cap and ADR 0084s Jira cap cannot be reused because positive Jira Retry-After is an authoritative lower bound. Recommended default: 3 physical attempts total and 15 seconds cumulative sleep per logical operation; nonzero jittered 1/2-second fallback windows; defer with retry_not_before whenever the provider delay plus one request timeout does not fit the shared allowance/deadline. Permit at most one immediate core observe-and-replan cycle for commit_unknown/conflict/drift, sharing rather than resetting that budget. Full notes: .joe-janitor/rp03-jira-failure-taxonomy.md. No production/tracked files or RP-04 state changed.
